_comment: No B-roll splice this reel -- segments are already very short (3.7-13.0s) for a 26.6s total; a 1.3s motion-graphic cutaway would eat 25-35% of the shorter segments and fight the countdown's own pacing (hero number slams + badges + zoom hits already carry the 'energetic motion graphics' brief). All 3 cuts still get an energetic brand wipe instead of a flat cut, each a different style for variety across such a short runtime.
